create_mixed_mask_embedder: create a MixedMaskEmbedder that randomly selects from irregular, rectangle, full, and segmentation masks
build_random_irregular_mask: build random irregular masks with configurable line, circle, or square draw methods on a given image shape
build_random_rectangle_mask: build random rectangle masks with configurable size, margin, and overlap constraints on a given image shape
build_random_superres_mask: build random super-resolution masks with configurable step and width parameters on a given image shape
create_outpainting_mask: create outpainting masks that pad image edges with configurable probabilities and fixed randomness
